content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definitions
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by DRAGONFLY INNOVATIONS LLC, whether oral, written, electronic, or otherwise.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligations
content_blocks.text: RECEIVING PARTY shall maintain the confidentiality of CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of DRAGONFLY INNOVATIONS LLC.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Term
content_blocks.text: This NDA shall remain in effect until the expiration of five (5) years from the Effective Date.
